scenes.name: The Light Gates open
scenes.what: Marble gates with wings swing open to an ancestral orchestra; a line of figures, the POET among them, walks through into the radiant city.
lines: an orchestra of our ancestors wildest dreams
scenes.camera: low wide on the gates opening, POET entering frame from behind camera; reverse to the city glowing through
scenes.position: city boundary, the gate facing the field
scenes.here: the Light Gate, from the field
scenes.block: low wide on the ring opening, him entering from behind camera; reverse into the glow

scenes.name: Road down, following comets
scenes.what: Past the gate the road descends into the luminous city under comets; generations of faces line the way.
lines: to follow comets to the capital city
scenes.camera: drone or crane following POET down the processional road, tilt up to comet streaks
scenes.position: processional road from the gate down toward the center
scenes.here: the processional road descending from the gate into the market
scenes.block: crane following him down; tilt up to the comets; the market's lights below

scenes.name: The city rises / here we are all one
scenes.what: Atlantis rises from the depths in golden light; diverse beings gather and look up together.
scenes.camera: extreme wide establishing as the city lifts, cut to POET in the gathering, faces lit from above
scenes.position: edge of the city center plaza
scenes.block: the aerial over the terraces (33), then him in the crowd lit from above

scenes.name: Jungle Interface and the heart-scan admission
scenes.what: Jungle merges into crystalline buildings over overgrown ruins; children and elders draw symbols in sand; a gate scans the POET's heart instead of a pass.
lines: the pact we've made here with nature
scenes.camera: handheld walk-through of vines on stone; insert of the heart-scan gate reading POET's chest
scenes.position: garden quarter between the gate road and the center
scenes.block: handheld through vines on stone; insert of the heart-scan (34)

scenes.name: City Center: all safe
scenes.what: Back at the center, now fully alive; a ring of protective light encircles the community; unknown architecture glows.
lines: But here we are all safe
scenes.camera: slow 360 orbit around POET in the plaza
scenes.here: the cathedral square, under the dish
scenes.block: slow 360 orbit with him at the centre; the forum lit, children under the dish (14, 16)

scenes.name: Narrow streets by candlelight
scenes.what: POET walks stone alleys barely two people wide; candle flame blooms, shadows stretch, families gather behind lit windows, children's laughter, clouds set free.
scenes.camera: Steadicam behind POET down the alley (never a face-on EX; none present), candle close-ups, window POVs
scenes.here: the hidden stairwells, two people wide
scenes.block: Steadicam behind him; candle close-ups; window POVs (45, 61, 44)

scenes.name: Could stay forever, then wandering to the house
scenes.what: He sits a moment as Atlantis shines; voiceover ends ('welcoming me, & welcoming all'), he keeps wandering and arrives at a house where people are entering, and goes in.
scenes.camera: seated medium then wide; later documentary-style wandering (Mexico City footage) ending on a doorway with people filing in
scenes.position: residential street off the Narrow Streets, at the house door
scenes.here: the Container Rows to the House door
scenes.block: seated medium then wide; ends on the doorway with people filing in (19, 20)

districts.name: The Light Gate & Central Plaza

districts.sound: the ancestral orchestra; the heart-scan's tone; ten thousand people breathing
districts.camera: low wide on the gate with him entering from behind camera; the reverse into the glow; the aerial over the round plaza; a 360 orbit
districts.light_tech: the gate's white ceramic lit from inside; fences of light at the perimeter (cyan, high-frequency)
districts.arch: the ceramic ring; the perimeter of light (a fence you can see through); the round plaza with its terraces; the hall of crystal trees (the Jungle Interface)
districts.language: the gate is the city's largest ring: a threshold; its seam drawn in cyan top to bottom

places.name: the round plaza

places.name: the hall of crystal trees

districts.camera: the slow 360 orbit (06 'all safe'); the empty square from a high corner at dawn

vignettes.name: the forum at dawn

districts.name: Naraka Market
districts.tone: Atlantis from below: the warm underworld the spires stand on; twilight that never ends
districts.hour: kept at twilight by its own light even at 1 a.m. (06 streets, 07 house)
districts.sound: many radios, a kettle, the DJ through the walls, rain on corrugated roofs
districts.camera: Steadicam behind him down alleys two people wide; candle and window close-ups; the crowd at chest height
districts.light_tech: the Relighting: neon and string lights, candles in the alleys; teal and pink
districts.arch: shipping containers stacked two to four high into shops and rooms; corrugated awnings; cable webs and string lights; hidden stairwells between walls; the underpass flooded into a shadow-pool; the teahouse
districts.language: rust plated in ceramic, seams drawn by Glaziers at every container door; the salt line is chalked here, not painted (Night of the Line)

places.name: the House

places.name: the underpass shadow-pool

vignettes.name: a market at dusk forever
